title: Messier 78: a reflection nebula in Orion

geometryEvidence.reference: A picture of the sky: the plane is the picture's own tangent plane, perpendicular to the sight line through the picture's centre, so it faces the Sun. That centre is 165.8 arcsec from the nebula's position, which is the whole of the recipe's inclination. Not a measured orientation of the nebula.

registration.method: The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.5165 arcsec per pixel, north 1.6° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 86.6729501°, 0.0946682°. Not measured against Gaia here.

displayModel: The picture lies on one flat plane facing the Sun at the nebula's distance. Nothing in the picture has depth: seen from the side it is a line.
coverage: The published frame inside a circle: the picture fades out between 70% and 98% of half its short side, so its corners are not drawn and no straight edge shows. Its stars are removed before the bake by NOX, which predicts the light under a star and does not measure it.

acquisition.operation: Download the publisher's JPEG; no crop or resample.
